message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Liu X X is suspected of embezzlement but insufficient evidence. However, during investigation, Liu colluded with others to fabricate false facts, instructed a witness to lie, and gave false statements to investigators. This is obstruction of justice, specifically "伪证罪" (giving false testimony) or "妨害作证罪" (obstructing testimony). Also "指使他人作伪证罪" (inducing others to give false testimony). Under Chinese criminal law, article 307 (now 307?) deals with "伪证罪" (false testimony) includes: (1) giving false testimony, (2) refusing to testify, (3) destroying evidence, (4) inducing others to give false testimony. So Liu's acts: (i) instructing witness to lie (inducing false testimony) and (ii) making false statements to investigators (giving false statements). So the charge is "伪证罪". Possibly also "妨害司法公正罪"? Actually there is "妨害司法公正罪" (obstructing justice) under article 308? In Chinese law, there is "妨害司法公正罪" (obstructing the administration of justice) includes: (1) influencing judges, (2) interfering with evidence, (3) false statements, (4) etc. But typical classification: "伪证罪" is for false testimony; "指使他人作伪证罪" is a specific form. The description: "指使证人作伪证" is covered under article 307, paragraph 2: "指使他人作伪证的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制". So the appropriate charge: "伪证罪". Possibly also "妨害作证罪"? Actually "妨害作证罪" is not a separate crime; it's part of "伪证罪". So answer: [罪名]伪证罪<eoa>.
